City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 24, 2018 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.

4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation on San Diego International Airport Development Plan by San Diego County Regional Airport Authority staff member Dennis Probst, Vice President, Development
4B.
San Diego County Library Presentation by Deputy Director Donna Ohr and Principal Librarian Bill Sannwald
4C.
Quarterly Status Report presented by Peder Norby
4D.
EnerGov Update presented by Principal Planner Smith
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 10, 2018 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2018-10-24 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2018-10-24 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Extend temporary light use at Leo Mullen Sports Park for Encinitas Soccer League (Encinitas Express). Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Authorize the City Manager to extend the compliance agreement between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Soccer League (Encinitas Express) for temporary light use at Leo Mullen Sports Park for six months.
2018-10-24 Item 08C Extend Temporary Light Use at Leo Mullen Sports Park for Encinitas Soccer League (Encinitas Express)
8D.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2018-12 to adopt a modification suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2017-03, which amended Chapters 23.08 (Design Review) and 23.24 (Grading, Erosion and Sediment Control) and Titles 24 (Subdivisions) and 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans to address changes in state laws, correct errors and improve existing regulations. CASE NO: 16-141 ZA/SPA/LCPA; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
1) Conduct the public hearing; and 2) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2018-12, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting a Modification Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2017-03, which Adopted Amendments to Chapters 23.08 (Design Review) and 23.24 (Grading, Erosion and Sediment Control) and Titles 24 (Subdivisions) and 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans to Address Changes in State Laws, Correct Errors and Improve Existing Regulations.”
2018-10-24 Item 08D Ordinance 2018-12 Second Reading
8E.
2018 Major Special Event Memorandums of Understanding. Contact Person: Management Analyst Roff
City Council receives the report, acknowledges completion and fulfillment of the 2017 and 2018 special event community benefit memorandums of understanding and ends future memorandums of understanding regarding special event community benefits.
2018-10-24 Item 08E Major Special Event Memorandums of Understanding
8F.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2018-11 to adopt a modification suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2018-01, which amended Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to define Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) and establish development standards for these units based on recent updates to State Law. CASE NO: 16-285 ZA/LCPA LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
1) Conduct the public hearing; and 2) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2018-11, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Modifications Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2018-01, which Adopted Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Define and Establish Development Standards for Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), Based On Recent Updates to State Law.”
2018-10-24 Item 08F Acessory Dwelling Units
8G.
Notice of Completion for the ADA Sidewalk Improvements Phase 1 (CS18C). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
City Council takes the following actions: 1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion
2018-10-24 Item 08G ADA Sidewalk Improvements Phase 1 (CS18C) Notice of Completion
8H.
Superion (formerly known as H.T.E.and Sungard Public Sector) Annual Software Maintenance (ASM) renewal. Contact Person: IT Project Manager Salmon
City Council takes the following action: 1. Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the contract, in substantial form, for the Superion Annual Software Maintenance not to exceed $61,440 for the annual support period covering 7/1/2018-6/30/2019.
2018-10-24 Item 08H Superion (H.T.E.) Annual Software Maintenance Renewal
8I.
I-Net Fiber Build-Out between City Hall and Fire Station 1. Contact Person: IT Supervisor Contreras
City Council takes the following actions: 1) Authorize the City Manager to terminate the contract with STC Traffic, Inc. for the purpose of providing engineering design and related services executed on September 17, 2015 with a final amount expended of $146,811, returning $6,189 to the Governmental/Educational Access (213) fund; 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as attached with STC Traffic, Inc. in the amount of $13,200 plus 20% contingencies of $2,640 for project management and related services of Fire Station 1 fiber installation, for a total contract amount of $15,840; 3) Approve the contract plans and specifications for fiber installation between City Hall and Fire Station 1; 4) Authorize the advertisement for bids to be received for construction of the fiber network between City Hall and Fire Station 1; and 5) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-84 amending the FY 2018-19 budget to appropriate the Governmental/Educational Access (213) fund budget by $63,492.
2018-10-24 Item 08I I-Net Fiber Build-Out between City Hall and Fire Station 1
8J.
Notice of Completion for the Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation 2016-17 Project (CC04E) & (CE04H). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion
2018-10-24 Item 08J Notice of Completion - Sewer Rehab 2016-17
8K.
Construction agreement for Pavement Rehabilitation and Roadway Sealing Project FY 2018-2019, Encinitas Boulevard Guardrail, and General Mobility Improvements. Contact Person: Civil Engineer Milligan
It is recommended that City Council: 1) Award contract to Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction in the amount of $846,403; 2) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a construction agreement with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction, in substantial form, in the amount of $846,403 plus 15% contingency for a total project not to exceed amount of $973,363 for the Pavement Rehabilitation and Roadway Sealing Project FY 2018-2019, Encinitas Boulevard Guardrail, and General Mobility Improvements; and 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2018-91 entitled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget."
2018-10-24 Item 08K Construction Agreement for Pavement Rehab and Roadway Sealing Project FY 2018-19, Encinitas Blvd. Guardrail and General Mobilility Improvements

10A.
Continued review and discussion regarding preliminary results of an economic feasibility analysis, and Planning Commission recommendations thereof, to evaluate an increase in the percentage of inclusionary housing requirements; adoption of Resolution 2018-90 approving an off-cycle budget appropriation of $106,000 to conduct further analysis related to the preparation of a nexus study, gap analysis, and financial feasibility analysis for the Inclusionary Ordinance Update, and authorization for the City Manager to sign contract Amendment #1 with Keyser Marston Associates, Inc. for additional costs and a revised scope of work for the completion of the Inclusionary Ordinance Update. CASE NO: 15-162 ZA/LCPA; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager and Associate Planner Winter
Staff recommends that the Council: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-90 approving an off-cycle budget appropriation of $106,000 to conduct further analysis related to the preparation of a nexus study, gap analysis, and financial feasibility analysis for the Inclusionary Ordinance Update (WC15E); and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign Contract Amendment #1 with Keyser Marston Associates, Inc. (KMA), for additional costs and a revised scope of work which will increase the contract budget of$65,000 in an amount not-to-exceed $106,000, for a total authorized contract budget of $171,000 for the completion of the Inclusionary Ordinance Update.
2018-10-24 Item 10A Inclusionary Housing
10B.
Habitat for Humanity Project at 750 Leucadia Blvd. Contact Person: Sr. Management Analyst McSeveney
1)Approve the 55-year ground lease agreements with Habitat for Humanity San Diego, in substantial form, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney, for
two City-owned parcels at 750 Leucadia Blvd., and directs the Mayor to execute the agreements; 2) Approves sharing of lawyer fees with Habitat for Humanity San Diego for the preparation
of the ground lease agreements, in the amount of $10,000; 3) Approves budget Resolution 2018-86 appropriating $10,000 from the unreserved balance of the General Fund into the City Attorney budget for the payment of said lawyer fees; and 4) Waives up to $24,000 in City building permit fees for up to two Habitat for Humanity homes conceptually envisioned to be built on vacant land at 750 Leucadia Blvd.
2018-10-24 Item 10B Habitat for Humanity

2018 Legislative Review and Addition to Legislative Priorities. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
1) Receive the 2018 Legislative session report; and 2) Approve the addition of “Community Choice Energy” to Council’s Legislative Priorities.
2018-10-24 Item 10C Legislative Program

City of Encinitas 2017-2019 Strategic Plan and Project Status Report.
Approve the City of Encinitas 2017-2019 Strategic Plan and receive the City of Encinitas Project Status Report - October 24, 2018 (biannual update).
2018-10-24 Item 10D Strategic Plan

ADJOURNMENT - The next regular meeting of the City Council is November 14, 2018.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
